name: Hope
overview: Biblical hope is a confident expectation rooted in God's faithfulness and promises, distinct from empty or false hope exemplified by the wicked whose hopes perish (Job 8:13; 11:20; 27:8). True hope is found in God alone, as trusting in worldly riches or self-confidence leads to judgment (Job 31:24, 28). This hope sustains believers by anchoring their souls and empowering them to endure with courage, reflecting the assurance that God will fulfill His promises to His people (Joshua 1:6).
